purpose: A Java library built with Maven through its committed Maven Wrapper, Java 17 set by maven.compiler.release, every version fixed in pom.xml, and JUnit 5 tests. It runs in the Java 17 image as the host's user with user.home set to the audit's home, so ~/.m2 is the same on every machine. The build loads Surefire's test provider without running a test, so the offline test run passes 4 of 4, the planted faults compile and are caught, and the library reaches Level 2.
